name: Hongcheon Cloud Data Center Complex
developer: Osung D&C / Welcome Asset Management consortium
notes: Gangwon-do and Hongcheon-gun signed an investment agreement for a cloud data center complex in Hongcheon; trade/local reports describe a multi-hundred-billion-won project with completion targeted later in the decade, but no reliable MW figure found.

name: Pyeongchang Peace Data Center
developer: Peace Data Center Co. / Pyeongchang County private investment proposal
notes: Pyeongchang promoted a 'Peace Data Center' project linked to the 2018 Winter Olympic host area, but later reports said the project stalled/collapsed after land and financing disputes; marked rejected/stalled rather than active.

name: Samcheok Bit Dream Fuel Cell Power Plant Data Center
developer: Korea Southern Power / Samcheok City partner plan
notes: Korea Southern Power publicized a plan to use heat/electricity from the Samcheok Bit Dream fuel-cell power plant to host a data center; no standalone MW data-center capacity found.

name: Samcheok Blue Power Eco-Friendly Data Center
developer: Samcheok Blue Power / Gangwon-do / Samcheok City
notes: Gangwon-do/Samcheok announcements described an eco-friendly data center investment agreement using Samcheok Blue Power infrastructure; project details remained preliminary and no MW figure found.

name: Taebaek Abandoned Mine Underground Data Center Concept
notes: Taebaek and Gangwon sources discussed attracting data centers to abandoned mine or cool underground spaces as a mine-region reuse strategy; no confirmed operator, capacity, or construction evidence found.

name: Wonju MegaData Korea AI Data Center
notes: Wonju City announced a major AI data center investment in Dangu-dong by MegaData Korea, with reported 120 MW power scale and construction/groundbreaking activity in 2026; local reporting places total investment around KRW 1.4 trillion.

name: Wonju Cloud Data Center Project
notes: Gangwon-do and Wonju City signed an MOU with Seonjin CCS for an 80 MW cloud data center project in Wonju; sources describe an investment on the order of KRW 800 billion.

name: Wonju Enterprise City AI Data Center Site
developer: WonjuIDC / KT participation under letter of intent
notes: Reports describe WonjuIDC securing an Enterprise City site and KT signing a letter of intent for an AI data center aimed at global technology tenants; capacity was not confirmed in public sources reviewed.
